cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's discuss our quiz preparation, not the final score. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did we come last?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We identified the greatest number of learning opportunities.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many points did we get?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, appreciate how bravely we attempted the geography round.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The race taught us a lot about pacing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stopped halfway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A natural point for reviewing the first half.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everybody else finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And missed a valuable opportunity to reassess their strategy mid-course.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You beat me at chess. Take a photograph of the board. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I wanted to explore the rest of my team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found the finishing move. Let the photograph remember that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.text: You beat me at chess. Take a photograph of the board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you use your queen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted to explore the rest of my team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found the finishing move. Let the photograph remember that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It stayed in the kitchen where I can admire it privately.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still beat seven cakes that had every intention of winning.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You look disappointed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me your choice first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You look disappointed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me your choice first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever makes you happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does it matter now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Losing the entry fee bought us a complete map of the competition. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We entered to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A short-term interpretation of the investment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't afford another entry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the information has become exclusive. We'll use it selectively.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Losing the entry fee bought us a complete map of the competition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We entered to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A short-term interpretation of the investment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't afford another entry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the information has become exclusive. We'll use it selectively.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Selling the stall at a loss freed us for a much bigger opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which opportunity?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We now know precisely which business not to buy again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an expensive lesson.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We couldn't have learned it at this depth for free.

cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.
